brief: Explain a stack: push A, push B, then pop B to demonstrate last-in, first-out.

coverage.observation: A rests at the bottom of the outlined stack after leaving the input position; the first push label is highlighted.
B is above A within the same stack, with the second push step highlighted.
B is now at the output while A stays at the stack bottom, showing last-in-first-out without a character narrative.

declared_review.notes: Implementation-model review of actual overview/contact-sheet images and selected action frames. Sampled-frame review only; normal-speed playback and audio listening were not assessed. This is an authored regression demonstration, not an independent other-LLM transfer result. After the stroke-visibility diagnostic fix, every regenerated preview PNG was hash-identical to the previously inspected output; the same observations apply to this current preview.
